slides.title: UN appeal for people who fled to Kenya
Who is asking
slides.body: UNHCR, IOM, UNICEF and WFP launched an appeal for $8.9 million to help up to 50,000 displaced people over three months.

slides.title: Who has crossed
slides.body: UNHCR says thousands crossed into Kenya via Moyale since Oct 22. Local authorities estimate up to 50,000. Many are women and children, sheltering in schools, churches or with host families.

slides.title: What is still unknown
slides.body: Registration and verification are ongoing, so figures are estimates. IOM says partners are preparing for more arrivals. Single report, not independently verified.

slides.title: Fund and open safe access to aid.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
